issue_request: The Published/Persuasive FHIR-core issue asked for extension definition Summary views to label the root row with the extension name rather than the generic "extension" label, for both complex and simple extensions.
initial_application: SVN revision 14851, imported as git commit bbf3d10a30e4a5ea53d365619f9121867da4cb6a, changed ProfileUtilities.generateExtensionTable so non-full extension tables use ed.getName(), while full structure tables continue to show extension or modifierExtension.
additional_context: The old Java renderer containing the application was later removed from this checkout with other Java implementation code. Current core source still has the extension template split between Summary using <%extension-table false%> and Full Structure using <%extension-table true%>. Published R4 extension pages generated after the fix show the intended distinction. Current extension-pack/IG Publisher rendering is outside this core source reconciliation.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The issue was historically applied, the current core checkout has no remaining renderer implementation to correct, and changing extension StructureDefinition XML or adding prose would not address the requested renderer behavior.
